description:
Summary:

Previously if we detected a layout conflict for a MultiTemplateBuffer, we still call `get_min_choice` which triggers autotuning. This is a small health fix to not call autotuning in this case when we don't need to

Test Plan: Small refactor

Reviewed By: njriasan, jananisriram

title: [Inductor] Only autotune if there are no layout conflicts (#182341)
